profile.description: Confirmed Adventure Zone booking for the 2027 Big Sky Country State Fair in Bozeman. This is an established relationship from the 2025 RMAF convention, not an outreach lead.

notes.subject: 2027 confirmed booking - signed contract received
notes.body: Gmail history shows Kara Urdahl continued the relationship after the 2025 RMAF convention and selected Pirate's Rebellion for the 2027 fair. The signed contract was returned March 25, 2026; Adventure Zone acknowledged receipt and confirmed the event on the calendar March 26. On March 31 Kara said she will be the point of contact and provided cell 406-548-8438. Do not treat the old Gallatin auto-reply as the latest relationship event.

followUps.reason: Confirmed booking. Reconfirm operational details, point of contact and remaining pre-event needs with Kara before the July 21-25, 2027 fair.
